key_facts: UPDATED Wednesday August 5 (T+1d, Election Day TOMORROW Thu Aug 6 7am-7pm CDT; REBALANCED SLIGHTLY BACK TO OGLES: Andy Ogles 0.48->0.52, Charlie Hatcher 0.52->0.48; sum=1.00): (1) HEAVY PRE-ENDORSEMENT EARLY VOTE & SUBURBAN SURGE (WSMV Aug 5, TN Star Aug 4): Statewide GOP early voting hit a massive 396,677 ballots (above 2022/2018) and CLOSED Sat Aug 1 — 3 days BEFORE Gov. Bill Lee's Aug 4 endorsement! County-level early voting surged +80% in Wilson, +41% in Williamson, and +37% in Rutherford vs 2024, while Hatcher's rural base Maury County grew only +6% — neutralizing Lee's endorsement for ~45-50% of the electorate and tempering Hatcher's rural-map thesis. (2) INTERNAL POLL STILL HAD OGLES AHEAD (TN Star/WPLN Aug 4-5): Even the pro-Hatcher Invest in Tomorrow Coalition Super PAC's own poll showed incumbent Ogles leading 36.9% to 32.7% (+4.2 pts, ~30.4% undecided); WPLN confirms internal polls are 'neck-and-neck'. (3) LEE ENDORSEMENT VIDEO CONFIRMED BUT LOW-KEY + STRONG TRUMP TELE-RALLY (The Hill/WPLN Aug 4-5): Gov. Bill Lee confirmed his endorsement in a Facebook video posted by Hatcher ('25-year friend... our veterinarian', NOT posted on Lee's official governor channels) and praised Hatcher as aligned with Trump, while Trump's July 28 tele-rally during early voting strongly urged votes for Ogles ('terrific guy... source of inspiration'). (4) TRUE TOSS-UP (48% Hatcher): Hatcher still has massive Election Day upside via ~3:1 total spending ($2M ITC + $719K raised vs $666K Freedom Caucus + $613K), Lee+Haslam+Perdue endorsements, redrawn map, and anti-incumbent undecided break against an incumbent stuck at 36.9%.
